build: AP Calculus AB Textbook Unit 2 Warm-Ups + Exit Tickets
warmup_rule: Section 2.1 Day 1 exactly preserves the current Unit 1 Day 1 algebra readiness warm-up. All later warm-ups use a rolling Unit 2 rotation, mixing the newest section with retrieval from earlier Unit 2 sections.
exit_rule: Algebra 1 philosophy adapted directly: two tickets per section; N1/N2 are current-section evidence; R1/R2 reassess the immediately previous official ticket N1/N2; four same-day print versions rotate evidence positions cyclically. Section 2.1 Ticket A uses two opening-new jobs because no prior AP Calculus exit chain exists.

N1.job: Evaluate a finite limit algebraically by selecting and executing an appropriate simplification strategy.

N2.job: Connect average rates on shrinking intervals to an instantaneous rate of change.

O1.job: Distinguish the limiting value from the actual function value at the approached input.

O2.job: Use one-sided behavior to determine whether a two-sided limit exists.

N1.job: Determine finite limits at positive and negative infinity and connect them to horizontal asymptotes/end behavior.

N2.job: Determine infinite one-sided limits at a vertical asymptote and describe left/right behavior.

N1.job: Apply the definition of continuity to determine a parameter or extension value that makes a function continuous.

N2.job: Use the Intermediate Value Theorem to justify existence of an input producing a specified output.

N1.job: Use a difference quotient limit to find the instantaneous slope/rate at a point.

N2.job: Use the slope at a point to write tangent and normal line equations.

repair_note: Notation cleanup: simplified subtraction of negative constants (for example x--2 to x+2), omitted coefficient 1 on variable terms (for example 1x^2 to x^2 and -1t to -t), and removed first-power notation if present. Mathematical values, evidence jobs, ticket rotation, and warm-up content are unchanged.
